task_package_head_rule: Resolve and freeze the remote baseline branch after this package commit. Start every branch at that exact package SHA, which descends from code_checkpoint. The package cannot embed its own commit SHA.
remote_handling: Local remote github points to GitHub; local origin points to a different server. Push only the verified GitHub remote. No develop merge, rebase, reset or force push.

topology.shared_cargo_target: one build/test owner at a time
topology.followup: Reuse an idle first-wave agent for control/budgets; no extra simultaneous environment or worker.

dependencies: M shared prerequisites -> B/A/C as required
B original ownership prerequisites -> A detour consumers
B -> C only for explicitly borrowed providers
all implementation -> unified cloud candidate -> local qualification
